summary:
Measuring data and analytics initiatives is critical for data and analytics leaders to understand the effectiveness and impact of their strategies, as well as earn trust with leadership and peers. By setting clear metrics, KPIs and mechanisms organizations can track the progress of their initiatives and identify areas for improvement.

Hosted by Irina Koitz at Johnson Controls, join this session to discuss how to:

Communicate the value of ROI of initiatives to stakeholders effectively
Use real-world examples to illustrate impact
Discover new opportunities to stay ahead of shifting market demands

Join these Peer Meetups, powered by Gartner CDAO Communities, for a networking session that allows you to connect and share with a small group of your peers facilitated by a CDAO Community Member. Please make every effort to attend as other attendees will be looking forward to meeting with you.
